headline: Philippine Central Bank Proposes Direct Payment Access for Fintechs
summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas proposed regulations allowing fintech companies to process digital payments directly from customer bank accounts and e-wallets under new security licensing.
why: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the central monetary authority governing the banking and digital financial ecosystem in the Philippines.

impacts.name: Philippine Financial Technology
impacts.why: Fintech firms would gain direct integration to core banking and payment clearing systems.
